contrastMethod: Actual computed sRGB foreground, background and border colors, composited through opaque/transparent ancestor fills. No gradients, whole-element opacity, filters or blend modes are accepted in the measured path. Visible HTML text requires 4.5:1 (large text 3:1); field border against both fill and parent requires 3:1; buttons require a border or fill distinguishable from their parent at 3:1. External keyboard outline is measured against its adjacent parent at 3:1. Box shadows are not RGB backgrounds: structural checks require all readable neumorphic content inside a 12px-inset opaque, shadow-free child above the paired shading. Temporary screenshots receive bounded visual inspection. Every measured sample is retained in the raw report.

limits: Chromium only; no screen reader, physical device, other browser engine, native zoom/text enlargement, backend or performance benchmark.

Profiles preserve 15 extracted source variables. Neumorphic hosts retain source panel corners with per-corner max(0px, host minus 12px) opaque faces; ordinary native fields retain source control geometry. This is not full theme composition, typography, assets, density or intended font-binary rendering.

Contrast excludes hidden/placeholder text, native select popups, browser validation bubbles, glyph internals, SVG paths and antialiasing; visible decorative HTML text remains measured. Unsupported constructs in measured scope fail rather than silently passing.
A semantic native control, arithmetic pass or bounded screenshot is not full accessibility conformance. Design-fit judgments are reasoned source reviews, separate from browser behavior.
Screenshots remain temporary. No account, backend, agent authority or external network dependency is present.
